districtFact: Edmonds School District serves south Snohomish County from its Lynnwood office, with schools across Brier, Edmonds, Lynnwood, Mountlake Terrace, Woodway, and nearby unincorporated areas. Its family calendar separates the grades 1–12 opening, Kindergarten Family Connection meetings, the first kindergarten day, and the first Edmonds Preschool day. The 2026–27 calendar marks most in-session Fridays for a 75-minute early release, while conference half days and districtwide half days follow different schedules.

about.title: About Edmonds School District
about.content: Edmonds School District is a preschool-through-grade-12 public district headquartered in Lynnwood. The district reports more than 20,000 students across 34 schools in south Snohomish County and identifies Brier, Edmonds, Lynnwood, Mountlake Terrace, Woodway, and parts of unincorporated Snohomish County as the communities within its service area.

about.title: An Opening Schedule Split Across Three Programs
about.content: The first day printed for grades 1–12 is not the first ordinary day for every student. Kindergarten begins after Family Connection meetings, and Edmonds Preschool starts later in September. Families with children in more than one program should plan from the program-specific date rather than a single districtwide opening date.

about.title: Friday Release Is a Recurring District Pattern
about.content: The 2026–27 calendar marks most Fridays when school is in session for a 75-minute early release, beginning September 11. The exact clock time depends on the school, and districtwide or elementary conference half-day schedules are shorter than the regular Friday release. ESD says start and end times remain unchanged for 2026–27; revised times begin in 2027–28.

about.title: The Live Calendar and PDF Serve Different Jobs
about.content: The one-page Family and Community Calendar is the clearest view of the approved year structure and color-coded schedule changes. The live district calendar contains ongoing events and offers RSS and iCal subscription options. Use the PDF for annual planning, then use the live district and school calendars for changes, program events, and school-specific details.

planningTips.title: Edmonds School District Calendar Notes
content: Match the first day to the student's program. Grades 1–12, kindergarten, and Edmonds Preschool start on different dates.
Treat Kindergarten Family Connection meetings as a separate opening phase, not as ordinary full kindergarten days.
For 2026–27, plan for a 75-minute early release on the Fridays marked in the family calendar, beginning September 11. Confirm the actual dismissal time with the school because bell times vary.
Do not confuse Friday early release with a conference half day or the districtwide half day. The latter schedules dismiss students earlier.
Elementary conference dates still include student attendance on a half-day schedule; they are not full no-school days.

Keep every snow make-up date provisional. ESD publishes the order in which reserved dates would be used, beginning with the May professional-development date and then moving beyond the scheduled last day.
Use ESD's live calendar subscription for ongoing updates. The MySchoolDates ICS and the district's printable PDF are point-in-time copies.

districtFaqs.q: Do kindergarten students start on the same day as grades 1–12?
districtFaqs.a: No. Grades 1–12 start September 2. Kindergarten Family Connection meetings are September 2–3 and September 8, and kindergarten classes begin September 9. Edmonds Preschool starts September 21.

districtFaqs.q: Do Edmonds schools dismiss early every Friday?
districtFaqs.a: Most Fridays when school is in session follow a 75-minute early-release schedule. For 2026–27, the first early-release Friday is September 11. Holidays, staff days, school breaks, conference half days, and districtwide half days interrupt the regular Friday pattern.

districtFaqs.q: Is there school on elementary conference days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Elementary students attend school on those conference dates, but they follow a half-day schedule. Check your school’s dismissal time rather than using the regular Friday early-release time.

districtFaqs.q: Can the last day of school change in Edmonds?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. June 22 is the scheduled last day. May 28 is the first possible snow make-up day; if more days are needed, ESD would use June 23, 24, 25, and 28, in that order.

districtFaqs.q: Does Edmonds publish a Spanish school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. ESD provides both English and Spanish one-page Family and Community Calendars for 2026–27.

districtFaqs.q: Will a downloaded Edmonds calendar update itself?
districtFaqs.a: A downloaded PDF or one-time ICS import will not update automatically. ESD's live calendar page provides RSS and iCal subscription options for ongoing district or school calendar updates.
